name: rivi-tools
description: Tools RIVI Software builds its apps with, published to npm and GitHub Packages under @rivi-software

scripts.fix: ultracite fix -A unicorn/catch-error-name -A typescript/consistent-type-definitions -A unicorn/prefer-dom-node-append -A unicorn/prefer-dom-node-dataset -A unicorn/prefer-query-selector -A unicorn/prefer-at -A unicorn/prefer-set-has -A unicorn/prefer-spread -A unicorn/prefer-bigint-literals -A unicorn/prefer-import-meta-properties -A unicorn/prefer-number-coercion -A unicorn/prefer-type-error -A unicorn/prefer-regexp-test -A unicorn/text-encoding-identifier-case -A unicorn/no-useless-undefined -A vitest/prefer-describe-function-title
scripts.test: pnpm -r run test && vitest run --dir scripts && vitest run --dir rivi-bot
scripts.verify: pnpm run check:manifests && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run check && pnpm run test && pnpm run build && pnpm run check:packages
